commonPromptUsed: Use case: illustration-story. Generate a NEW square Hugmap growth illustration. Reference image 1: TOP ROW MIMO ONLY is exact bird geometry; ignore old black colors and all other animals. Reference image 2: human morphology, relative scale and visual simplicity only; do not copy its scene. Warm fully opaque ivory #FFFCF7. Child and adult all WHITE fill including skin hair and clothes, completely blank face interiors, no eyes brows mouths. Rounded toddler simple 2-3 hair curves, white tee shorts. Mature adult proportions white long-sleeve shirt trousers. Human child soft salmon #F59B82 outlines, adult paler #F7C6B3. Smooth modest lineweight child outer4 inner3 adult outer3 inner2.5 at1536x1024 reference, scale coherently. Mimo compact egg-shaped head, tiny oval eyes, slim leaf crest, short sleeve white tee distinct rounded lower belly, short feather wings NOT human hands, thin legs three toes. Mimo outlines #A77C65, eyes #6B5143, expression lines #A77C65. Flat solid orange #FF511B collar without outline/internal strokes. Official small U plus two dots orange on upper viewer-right chest only if that actual shirt panel is visible; never force visibility. Child action primary, animal secondary and small. Clean quiet picture-book curves, low-contrast props, small pale contact shadows, generous negative space. NO speech bubbles, words, text, letters, watermark, labels, decorative halo, grain, gradients or busy background. Entire illustration a single scene, no panels.

scenes.instruction: Child standing left points to mother entering on right. Mother simple white bob hair, kneels opening one hand in acknowledgment. Small Mimo between them but lower and behind, follows the pointing direction. Clear triangle of child pointing, mother response and bird listening. Just a faint doorframe on far right.

Toddler at left holds one adult-sized pale taupe shoe with both hands toward father seated low at right. Matching other adult shoe beside father foot clearly links owner and object. Father short simple hair extends open hand to receive. Mimo standing small nearby watching shoe exchange. Sparse warm ivory entryway, no shelves.

Toddler at left lifts one foot ready to kick one pale mustard and sage ball, stable supporting foot grounded. Adult crouches at right holding a small TWO-card communication strip with simple ball pictogram and kicking-foot-with-ball pictogram; child points to ball with free hand. Mimo small at lower right watching child. This is communicating an intended action, not athletic instruction.

Toddler with simple white bob at left points upward at a single small pale sage toy car resting on TOP of a LOW pale cream shelf on right. Adult kneels beside child, follows same pointing direction. Mimo small next to shelf gazes upward toward exactly the same car. No climbing, no ladder, no reaching precariously. Shelf has one empty lower compartment to make top location clear.
scenes.finalEditPrompt: Precise localized character-model correction. Edit ONLY the small MIMO BIRD at lower right in IMAGE 1. IMAGE 2 TOP ROW MIMO ONLY is the official geometry reference; ignore its black line color and the other animals. Preserve the entire scene, people, pointing gesture, shelf, toy car, background, composition and bird's approximate size and foot position. Redraw Mimo as official compact upright EGG-shaped head with narrow crown and gently fuller lower cheeks, NOT a wide sideways oval or angular head. Body faces right in natural side/three-quarter profile with head tilted slightly upward looking at the toy car. ONE visible small dark oval eye placed naturally on the side of the head, a tiny curved eyebrow. A tiny TRIANGULAR BEAK must project OUTSIDE the front/right head silhouette toward the car; absolutely no square/diamond drawn inside the cheek. Slim single leaf crest rooted at crown following head tilt. White short-sleeve T-shirt with clearly defined sleeve cuff around wing root; short rounded feather wing hangs naturally from sleeve, two subtle feather tips, no fingers. Shirt hem separate from rounded lower white bird belly. Slim short legs and three-toed feet. Flat orange #FF511B neck scarf/collar without outline or internal lines. Bird outer outlines warm brown #A77C65, eye/beak detail dark brown #6B5143. White opaque body fill. Small orange U with two dots only if correct upper viewer-right shirt front panel is actually visible; natural side-view occlusion is fine. Keep supporting bird small, adorable, calm and proportionate according to reference. Preserve original warm opaque ivory background and all remaining pixels as closely as possible. No text, no reference sheet, no additional objects.

scenes.instruction: Toddler and adult kneel facing one another around THREE large separate picture cards on floor: a simple umbrella, a simple open box, and a simple elephant. Child points at umbrella card with one hand and makes a small open-palm gesture toward adult with other. Adult responds with an open hand. Mimo standing small beside cards opens one wing to acknowledge child. Keep card pictures clear low-detail pastel illustrations, no letters. Calm shared naming and sound play, no mouth close-ups or drills.
